Trust our merchandise to make you shine brighter than the brightest star.|Map|AoC}} is a recurring [[Jewelry Shop]] in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Features and Overview== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Starlight Memories is a [[Jewelry Shop]] in [[Gerudo Town]], owned by the jewelers [[Cara]] and [[Isha]].{{Cite|With that beast causing a ruckus and the guards in an uproar over some kind of theft, things have been pretty crazy. And on top of it all, my shop...|Cara|BotW}}{{Cite|I manage a shop that specializes in handmade accessories, but I've run out of {{Color BotW|Blue|flint}}. I need it to make my items.|Isha|BotW}} The [[Accessory|Accessories]] offered at the Jewelry Shop are crafted by Isha in a manner that channels the natural power of [[Gem]]s, allowing their wearers protection against certain elements.{{Cite|You see, each gem contains its own special power. Wearing one will grant you a form of protection. For example, {{Color BotW|Blue|sapphires}} offer resistance to intense heat, and {{Color BotW|Blue|rubies}} have the power to resist chilling temperatures. I'm able to craft {{Color BotW|Blue|circlets}} or {{Color BotW|Blue|earrings}} that channel these powers to protect the wearer.|Isha|BotW}} Since these Gems are difficult to obtain, however, Isha requires her customers to bring them as part of their payments.{{Cite|Sadly, the materials to make such items are difficult to get ahold of... That's why you have to bring me the materials.|Isha|BotW}} The Accessories at Starlight Memories are also unisex, being able to be worn by both men and women.{{Cite|Oh, and don't forget that voe and vai alike can enjoy these. They're great gifts if you want to impress someone, hehe.|Isha|BotW}} When [[Link]] first arrives in Gerudo Town, he will find that Starlight Memories is closed due to running out of [[Flint]] to work with. As part of the "[[Tools of the Trade]]" [[Side Quest]], Link must bring Isha 10 pieces of Flint so she can reopened the Jewelry Shop.{{Cite|If only I had {{Color BotW|Red|10}}... Just {{Color BotW|Red|10}}... If some kind vai would give me {{Color BotW|Red|10 pieces of flint}}, I could offer a nice reward...|Isha|BotW}} When Link delivers the Flint, Isha will thank him with a gift of either a [[Ruby Circlet]], a [[Sapphire Circlet]], or [[Topaz Earrings]].{{Cite|[Here's some flint.] Uh... What?! You're just...giving these to me? Sarqso! But...I can't take this all from you with just a sarqso. We hardly know each other, and you've been so nice... The shop's been closed so long, I hardly have any inventory... Oh, of course! Now that I have some {{Color BotW|Blue|flint}}, I could make a jeweled accessory for you if you're interested in something.|Isha|BotW}} She also invites Link to come back to the Jewelry Shop in the future, offering him a special discount if he does so.{{Cite|Thanks to you, I got the shop running again, so if you ever need an accessory, please come by for a special discount. Just...don't tell my other customers, {{Small|OK?}}|Isha|BotW}} Following the completion of "Tools of the Trade", Link will be able to buy Accessories from Starlight Memories.{{Cite|Thanks to your hard work, our lives are finally back to normal. Sarqso! To show my thanls, I'll offer you a special price. Just pick up any {{Color BotW|Blue|accessory}} you're interested in.|Isha|BotW}}{{Cite|I have enough {{Color BotW|Blue|flint}} now, so I can work every day! If you want any {{Color BotW|Blue|accessories}}, could you pick them yourself?|Isha|BotW}} Whenever Link makes a purchase, Isha might thank him for doing so.{{Cite|Heehee, sarqso.|Isha|BotW}} She can also wish for the Gems in his new Accessory to offer him protection.{{Cite|Heehee. May you have the protection of the gems.|Isha|BotW}}{{Cite|Sarqso. May you have the protection of that gem.|Isha|BotW}} Isha may also comment that the Accessory suits Link.{{Cite|Sarqso! That accessory really is your style!|Isha|BotW}} ====Wares and Pricing==== {{Wares|game= BotW |prices= Rupees, Materials |- |{{Wares/Item |item= Amber Earrings |price1= 100 |price2= 10 Amber |stock= 1 |description= One of the items sold by the Gerudo jeweler. It's decorated with a diamond, which harnesses the power of light to increase attack power. }} }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} [[File:AoC Dearest Stars Thumbnail.png|thumb|left|320px|alt= An in-game thumbnail depicting Dearest Stars.|Dearest Stars as seen in {{AoC|-}}]] Dearest Stars opens near [[Gerudo Town]] after completing the "[[Wanted: Shop Assistant]]" [[Quest]], which appears after finishing the [[Urbosa, the Gerudo Chief]] [[Scenario]]. [[Seru]]'s parents are worried about her taking over the [[Shop]] on her own, so she needs [[Rupee]]s in order to hire a shop assistant.{{Cite|Some parents are worried for their daughter, who took over their shop. She needs an assistant to help with tasks that can sink a shop if left unhandled. For that, she'll need money.|Gallery (Interface)|AoC}} Once she has the funding for this, she invites the [[Warrior]]s to come back in the future, which unlocks the Shop.{{Cite|With the money you brought, the shop owner hired some help, and her parents were glad to see their daughter turn the shop around. Stop by to buy things anytime.|Gallery (Interface)|AoC}}{{Cite|{{Color AoC|Gray|Reward}}
Dearest Stars Opens|Map|AoC}} After Dearest Stars opens, the Warriors can to purchase [[Gem]]s from Seru.{{Cite|Anything catch your eye?|Seru|AoC}} They also have the option to sell their own [[Item]]s to her.{{Cite|Show me {{Typo|want|what}} you want to sell. I can't read minds.|Seru|AoC}} When the "[[Great Bridge Repairs]]", "[[The Lazy Guards]]", "[[The Marita Exchange]]", and "[[What Bad Weather?]]" Quests are completed, prices at Dearest Stars decrease by 10% each time.
